name: M&Ms Challenge
description: A multi-centre, multi-vendor cardiac MRI segmentation benchmark assessing algorithm robustness across scanners and disease types.
evaluation_method: Dice coefficient (primary), Hausdorff distance and volumetric overlap metrics
general_score_metric: Dice coefficient (mean Dice across cardiac structures)
reputation: Well-known multi-centre cardiac MRI segmentation challenge used by the medical imaging community to evaluate generalization across scanners and pathologies.
notes: Medical imaging benchmark (non-LLM). Multi-vendor and multi-centre heterogeneity is a core challenge; dataset size is modest compared to natural-image benchmarks. Results can be sensitive to pre-processing and annotation protocols; submissions often evaluated via a central leaderboard to avoid overfitting.
